meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 通过 DeltaChat 集成加密邮件通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加端到端加密的邮件聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate encrypted email messaging via DeltaChat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add end-to-end encrypted email chat to your app

howto.what: 装上后，你的助手就多了一种沟通渠道：通过DeltaChat（用电子邮件聊天）收发消息，消息会加密，还会生成邀请链接和二维码供别人加它。
howto.when: 服务启动并配好DeltaChat账户后，当有人通过邀请链接或扫码加你并发来消息，或群组里有成员发言时，这个频道就会接管。

say.text: 请用add-deltachat技能把我的项目接入DeltaChat。
say.note: 会按安装步骤复制适配器文件并安装依赖。

say.text: 帮我填写DeltaChat的IMAP/SMTP配置到.env文件。
say.note: 包括邮箱、密码、服务器地址等。

say.text: 重启后看看DeltaChat适配器有没有正常启动。
say.note: 会检查日志中的启动记录和连接状态。

howto.what_en: After install, your assistant gains a new way to chat: via DeltaChat (email-based messaging) with encrypted messages. It also generates an invite link and QR code for others to connect.
howto.when_en: After the service starts and the DeltaChat account is configured, the channel takes over when someone adds you via invite link or QR code and sends a message, or when a member posts in a group.

say_en.text: Please use the add-deltachat skill to connect my project to DeltaChat.
say_en.note: It copies the adapter files and installs dependencies.

say_en.text: Help me fill in the DeltaChat IMAP/SMTP settings in the .env file.
say_en.note: Includes email, password, server host, etc.

say_en.text: After restart, check if the DeltaChat adapter started properly.
say_en.note: Checks logs for startup and connectivity.
